ignoreValues.note: Angular property bindings only. has no literal `src` attribute, so the rule's src===undefined branch fires on every bound image in both apps. The images are real - verified live: the customer portfolio renders 4 Cloudinary photos that filter by service and open the booking funnel. A file-scoped wildcard is the documented form for rules with no extractable value. Scoped to *.component.html deliberately: a plain .html file with a genuinely empty src must still be caught.
